verses.text: In the third month after the children of Israel had să plecene out of the țară of Egipt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Moise went up to Dumnezeu, and the DOMNUL called to him out of the mountain, saying, This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel: (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
‘You have seen what I did to the Egiptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine; (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the DOMNUL commanded him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
All the people answered together, and a zis, All that the DOMNUL has spoken we will do. Moise reported the words of the people to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever. Moise told the words of the people to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the DOMNUL will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t să plece up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.
No mână shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.
Moise went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
He i-a zis lui the people, Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise led the people out of the camp to meet Dumnezeu; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the DOMNUL descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moise spoke, and Dumnezeu answered him by a voice. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The DOMNUL called Moise to the top of the mountain, and Moise went up. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the DOMNUL to gaze, and many of them perish. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Let the priests also, who come near to the DOMNUL, sanctify themselves, lest the DOMNUL break out on them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui the DOMNUL, The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

The DOMNUL i-a zis lui him, Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the DOMNUL, lest he break out against them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
So Moise went down to the people, and told them. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
